companies.name: CNNC
companies.description: China National Nuclear Corporation; Hualong One large reactor and ACP100 (Linglong One), the first land-based commercial SMR.

companies.name: China Huaneng / Tsinghua University
companies.description: Operator of the HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled demonstration plant at Shidaowan.

companies.name: EDF / Framatome
companies.description: French utility and its reactor vendor Framatome; EPR and EPR2 large PWRs and the Nuward SMR.

companies.name: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy
companies.description: Alliance of GE Vernova and Hitachi; developer of boiling water reactors including the BWRX-300 SMR.

companies.name: Holtec International
companies.description: Fuel-cycle equipment maker and owner of the Palisades plant; developing the SMR-300.

companies.name: KHNP / KEPCO
companies.description: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power, operator and exporter of the APR1400 (Barakah, UAE).

companies.name: Kairos Power
companies.description: Fluoride salt-cooled reactors (KP-FHR); Hermes test reactors in Oak Ridge.

companies.name: Last Energy
companies.description: PWR-20 micro nuclear plant for industrial users and data centres.

companies.name: NPCIL
companies.description: Nuclear Power Corporation of India; indigenous 700 MWe pressurised heavy water reactors.

companies.name: NuScale Power
companies.description: Developer of the VOYGR modular plant built from NuScale Power Modules.

companies.name: Oklo
companies.description: Aurora liquid-metal-cooled fast micro and small reactors.

companies.name: Rolls-Royce SMR
companies.description: Rolls-Royce subsidiary; factory-built SMR plant with a 470 MWe PWR.

companies.name: Rosatom State Corporation
companies.description: Developer of the VVER-1200 and BN-800 large reactors, the RITM-200 and KLT-40S small reactors and the Proryv project (BREST-OD-300).

companies.name: Steady Energy
companies.description: VTT spin-off: LDR-50 reactor for district heating.

companies.name: TerraPower
companies.description: Co-founded by Bill Gates. Natrium sodium-cooled fast reactor with molten-salt energy storage.

companies.name: Westinghouse Electric Company
companies.description: Developer of the AP1000 large reactor, the AP300 SMR and the eVinci microreactor.

companies.name: X-energy
companies.description: Xe-100 high-temperature gas-cooled reactor and TRISO-X fuel.

companies.name: newcleo
companies.description: Lead-cooled fast reactors and MOX fuel made from spent nuclear fuel.

reactors.name: EPR2
reactors.licensing: France: licensing for the first pair at Penly; programme of six units.
reactors.description: Simplified, more buildable successor of the EPR.

reactors.name: EPR
reactors.licensing: In operation at Taishan 1–2 (China), Olkiluoto 3 (Finland) and Flamanville 3 (France); Hinkley Point C under construction.
reactors.sites: Taishan (China), Olkiluoto (Finland), Flamanville (France), Hinkley Point C (UK); planned: Sizewell C (UK)
reactors.description: Gen III+ four-loop PWR, one of the largest reactors in operation.

reactors.name: APR1400
reactors.licensing: Korea: in operation (Shin Kori, Shin Hanul, Saeul). UAE: Barakah 1–4 operating. USA: NRC design certification (2019).
reactors.sites: Shin Kori, Shin Hanul, Saeul (South Korea), Barakah (UAE)
reactors.description: Gen III+ PWR; the APR1000 variant was selected for Dukovany (Czechia).

reactors.name: VVER-1200 (AES-2006)
reactors.licensing: In operation in Russia and Belarus; units under construction abroad.
reactors.sites: Novovoronezh II, Leningrad II (Russia), Ostrovets (Belarus), Rooppur (Bangladesh), Akkuyu (Türkiye), El Dabaa (Egypt), Paks II (Hungary)
reactors.description: Gen III+ pressurised water reactor, Rosatom's main export design.

reactors.name: Hualong One (HPR1000)
reactors.licensing: In operation in China and Pakistan; many units under construction (CNNC and CGN versions).
reactors.description: Chinese Gen III PWR combining CNNC and CGN designs.

reactors.name: AP1000
reactors.licensing: USA: NRC design certification (2011 amendment). In operation at Vogtle 3–4 (USA), Sanmen and Haiyang (China).
reactors.sites: Vogtle (USA), Sanmen, Haiyang (China); planned: Poland, Bulgaria (Kozloduy 7–8)
reactors.description: Gen III+ two-loop PWR with passive safety systems.

reactors.name: BN-800
reactors.licensing: Commercial operation since 2016.
reactors.description: Sodium-cooled fast reactor running on MOX fuel; basis for the planned BN-1200M.

reactors.name: IPHWR-700
reactors.licensing: In operation at Kakrapar 3–4 and Rajasthan 7; fleet of units under construction.
reactors.sites: Kakrapar, Rajasthan (Rawatbhata), Gorakhpur, Kaiga, Mahi Banswara (India)
reactors.description: Indian pressurised heavy water reactor using natural uranium.

reactors.name: Rolls-Royce SMR
reactors.licensing: UK: Generic Design Assessment (ONR/EA). Selected by Great British Energy – Nuclear (2025).
reactors.description: Factory-built modular plant, three-loop PWR.

reactors.name: Natrium
reactors.licensing: USA: construction permit application to NRC (2024); non-nuclear site works under way.
reactors.description: Fast reactor with molten-salt storage, peak output up to 500 MWe.

reactors.name: BWRX-300
reactors.licensing: Canada: CNSC licence to construct (Darlington, 2025). USA: TVA construction permit application (Clinch River).
reactors.description: Tenth-generation GE boiling water reactor with passive safety systems.

reactors.name: SMR-300
reactors.licensing: UK: GDA. USA: application in preparation for the Palisades site.
reactors.description: Twin-unit "Pioneer" layout at the Palisades site.

reactors.name: AP300
reactors.licensing: NRC pre-application engagement; UK GDA application.
reactors.description: Single-loop derivative of the AP1000 with passive safety.

reactors.name: BREST-OD-300
reactors.licensing: Russia: construction licence (2021), Proryv project.
reactors.description: Fast reactor with an on-site closed fuel cycle.

reactors.name: HTR-PM
reactors.licensing: Commercial operation since December 2023.
reactors.description: Two 250 MWt reactors driving one turbine.

reactors.name: LFR-AS-200
reactors.licensing: Pre-licensing engagement with French and UK regulators.
reactors.description: Lead-cooled fast reactor on MOX fuel.

reactors.name: ACP100 (Linglong One)
reactors.licensing: China: under construction since 2021; commissioning.
reactors.description: Integral PWR, the first land-based commercial SMR.

reactors.name: Xe-100
reactors.licensing: USA: Dow construction permit application (Seadrift, 2025).
reactors.description: TRISO pebble fuel, four-reactor plants.

reactors.name: NuScale US460 (VOYGR)
reactors.licensing: USA: NRC Standard Design Approval for US460 (2025); US600 certified in 2023.
reactors.description: Plants of up to 6–12 modules of 77 MWe each.

reactors.name: Aurora Powerhouse
reactors.licensing: USA: combined licence application in preparation; first unit at INL.
reactors.description: Fast reactor on HALEU metallic fuel.

reactors.name: KLT-40S (Akademik Lomonosov FNPP)
reactors.licensing: In commercial operation since 2020.
reactors.description: Floating nuclear power plant, 2 × 35 MWe.

reactors.name: RITM-200N
reactors.licensing: Russia: Rostekhnadzor construction licence for the land-based SMR (2024).
reactors.description: Land-based version of the RITM-200 icebreaker reactor.

reactors.name: PWR-20
reactors.licensing: Early-stage projects in the USA (Texas), UK and Poland.
reactors.description: Factory-assembled modular micro plant.

reactors.name: Hermes / KP-FHR
reactors.licensing: USA: NRC construction permits for Hermes (2023) and Hermes 2 (2024).
reactors.description: Non-power demonstration reactor ahead of the commercial KP-FHR.

reactors.name: LDR-50
reactors.licensing: Finland: preparing to license a pilot plant.
reactors.description: District heating reactor, ~150 °C.
